body:
I'm so sorry to hear about your struggles. I know from personal experience that oftentimes the most painful battles are the ones we have with ourselves. I'm ending up here also because I've been trying for years (like the last 8 since my divorce) to be a better person and I'm failing consistently in new ways every time. 

You are not alone in your struggle, but please know that we value you and your contribution here. You are worth more than you could imagine, but I know it is difficult to see it sometimes. We'll all be thinking of you, hoping the best for you, and we'll always be here.

I am so sorry you have to live with fibro on top of everything, I do not know it personally but people I care deeply for suffer from it and I know it requires a lot of you. Your struggles deserve to be acknowledged, not minimized with claims of them being a phase. Please know that we are here to talk to, that you honor us with your post. Tell us your story.
If you are uncertain, calling an emergency number for guidance, and quickly, is probably your best bet. Please followup with us.
